kurz: Jam sets when [[pektin|pectin]], sugar and acid come together and enough water has boiled off.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Mix the fruit with sugar and let it sit
schluesselmomente.warum: The [[zucker|sugar]] draws juice out of the fruit.
Acid helps the pectin set and keeps the colour fresh.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Boil hard until the setting test works
schluesselmomente.warum: Water evaporates, and sugar and pectin concentrate.
Filled hot and sealed, it keeps longer.
